name: identity_fracture_vision
label: شاشات الوعي المتكسرة
godotFeature: ShaderMaterial with SCREEN_TEXTURE and viewport rendering
poeticVision: The player experiences Lyra's fractured mind directly. As memories fade, the world doesn't just decay; it misbehaves, contorts, and writhes. Objects momentarily shift their form, perspectives subtly warp, and familiar colors desaturate or bleed in unsettling patterns unique to each lost memory. This isn't just a filter; it's the visceral manifestation of Lyra's internal struggle, making every memory loss a tangible, distorting blow to her perception of reality, reinforcing the terrifying feeling of losing oneself.
usage: To apply this effect, create a 'ColorRect' node (or 'TextureRect') that covers the entire viewport. Assign a new 'ShaderMaterial' to its 'material' property. Load this '.gdshader' file into the 'Shader' property of the 'ShaderMaterial'. From GDScript, retrieve the 'ShaderMaterial' and update its uniform parameters (e.g., `material.set_shader_parameter("memory_integrity", lyra_memory_state)`) to dynamically control the visual distortions based on Lyra's memory integrity and specific in-game events.

parameters.name: memory_integrity
parameters.description: A value from 0.0 (fully lost) to 1.0 (intact) that controls the overall intensity of all distortion, desaturation, and color bleed effects. Lower values increase the visual manifestation of memory loss.

parameters.name: distortion_strength
parameters.description: The base strength of the screen-space warping and 'perceptual drift' effect. Higher values result in more pronounced visual contortions.

parameters.name: desaturation_factor
parameters.description: Determines how much color is removed from the scene as memories fade. A value of 1.0 would lead to full grayscale when memory_integrity is 0.0.

parameters.name: color_bleed_factor
parameters.description: Controls the intensity of the color channel mixing/bleeding effect, simulating a 'broken' or 'shifting' hue. Higher values create more noticeable color shifts.

parameters.name: noise_speed
parameters.description: The speed at which the underlying noise patterns for distortion and overlays animate, contributing to the 'writhing' and dynamic feel of the fractured vision.

parameters.name: noise_scale
parameters.description: The granularity or size of the noise patterns used for distortion and overlays. Higher values create finer, more detailed distortions; lower values create larger, more abstract shifts.

parameters.name: specific_pattern_intensity
parameters.description: A parameter to trigger or amplify unique, transient distortion patterns (e.g., ripples, waves) that can be tied to specific memory loss events or critical narrative moments. A value of 0.0 disables this specific pattern.

verdict: A fractured lens into a fracturing mind, this shader makes the terrifying erosion of self a constant, visceral reality for the player.
impact: This invention will profoundly deepen player immersion by making Lyra's internal struggle and the terrifying dissolution of her identity a constant, visceral visual experience. Every loss of memory will be a tangible blow to the player's perception of reality, directly reinforcing the game's core themes of self-loss and desperate survival.
